description: A GitHub import (orgmemory github convert of capture.json): approve labels added and removed by the wrong people, a dismissed review, a merge by a non-approver, an unmapped reviewer, a bot-opened PR, a reopen after a not-planned close, and a blocked-by link to a rejected issue.

validation.name: imported
validation.note: the dataset exactly as the importer wrote it validates

acme/api#1.note: The product manager's 'approved' label applies; the account manager's earlier label and the '/approve' comment do not. The 'Risk' label matches 'risk' case-insensitively.

acme/api#2.note: Changes requested by the product manager is a reject; re-requesting that reviewer is a request, so a reconsideration.

acme/api#3.note: Closed as not planned by the product manager.

acme/api#4.note: A bot's PR is only a comment, so nothing is pending; the unmapped account's approving review is ignored.

acme/api#5.note: A review later dismissed keeps its original verdict (approved) until the dismissal takes effect.

gh:acme/api#1/comment/1101.note: an unmapped account's '/approve' text is a comment, and the account has no role

gh:acme/api#1/event/1103.note: removing the account manager's label withdraws a decision that never applied

gh:acme/api#4/opened.note: a bot's opening is recorded as a comment by an actor with no role

acme/api#1.note: The account manager's removal of the label is an ignored revoke.

acme/api#2.note: The product manager's approving review decides; the engineer's merge is an ignored approve.

acme/api#3.note: The customer's reopen cannot withdraw the close, but the request that follows is a reconsideration.

acme/api#5.note: The product manager dismissed their own approving review: a valid revoke.

gh:acme/api#2/event/2205.note: a merge by an engineer is an approve the policy ignores

gh:acme/api#3/event/3302.note: a customer's reopen is a revoke the policy ignores

gh:acme/api#5/event/5502.note: product_manager may revoke, and the review is the decision in force
